'''Hakeem Island''' is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Location

'''Hakeem Island''' is located to the northwest of Centopia Island, the north of Orama Island and the east of Relish Island.

Transport

Railway

This island features Hakeem Station of the .

Road

Currently, this island features a main road connecting to Relish Island to the west and Centopia Island to the east, as well as a branch road connecting to Orama Island to the south.

In terms of roads within the island, a road runs along the southern perimeter of this island and ends with roundabouts at both the west and east ends. It runs under the branch road leading to Orama Island in the middle of this island directly to the south of Hakeem Station, and is connected to the main road by two different north-south oriented dual carriageways. Moreover, a Parking Lot is also built to the southeast of Hakeem Station.

Fun Facts

  • The name of this island '''Hakeem''' is taken from the Arabic language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which means "Wise".https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%85#Arabic</ref>

Future Development

Prior to the construction of Hakeem Station on this island, it was already announced that the station would be connected to a school surrounding the station, and when combined with the Chinese Name of this island, Wise, it implies that educational facilities may be built on this island in the future.

History

  • October 27 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • November 3 2023: The road link to Centopia Island completed construction.
  • November 19 2023: Hakeem Station began services. At the same day, the road link to Orama Island completed construction.

title: Halozy
safeHtml:
'''Halozy''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Twenty-Second Continent. It is currently under development.

History

Halozy is named after a Japanese Doujin Circle of the same name. Development plans were drafted on January 7 2020, and development began on the same day. The main purpose of Halozy Development is to balance the number of public and private housing in Twenty-Second Continent, therefore Halozy has a lower number of public housing than the rest of Twenty-Second Continent. (Public:Private Housing = 2:8)

Geography

Halozy mainly consists of desert terrain, and fluctuations in height are larger. Therefore, most of the developed land are derived from landscaping works.

Housing Estates

Fairscene Park

Fairscene Park is the first Housing Estate in Halozy. Fairscene Park provides 7'296 housing flats in its 24 buildings. The layout of the buildings forms a large space in the middle for shopping malls and public facilities. Currently, there is a Shopping Mall that provides daily necessities for its residents. For recreational facilities, there are 4 basketball courts, 2 football courts and a swimming pool that is open for its residents only.

Ying Lam Estate

Ying Lam Estate is the only Public Housing Estate planned in Halozy. Its 8 buildings provide a total of 5'120 housing flats.

Skyline Serenade

Skyline Serenade is an integrated housing project. Phase I of Skyline Serenade has a total of ten 44-storey buildings. Phase II features a 20-storey residential building, whereas Phase III has 54 independent buildings. However, green belts are also reserved within the planning feature of houses, and a 40-shop shopping street is also constructed in Phase III.

Facilities

Currently, Halozy has two secondary schools:

  • Serenade Road Secondary School
  • St. Peter Secondary School

And Two Primary Schools:

  • St. Lucas Primary School
  • Serenade Road Primary School

Recreational and Leisure Facilities:

In terms of recreational facilities, Halozy has a track field that can hold regional matches, and a services center featuring self-study rooms, a library, marriage registration offices and a Registration of Persons Offices. In the future, a standard stadium with a 5000-audience capacity and a stadium featuring a tennis court, a squash court, a tennis court and an indoors basketball court will be built.

  • Halozy Government Building
  • Good Queen Anne Memorial Park

  • Route 7

Transport

Nazca Railway

  • , Sheung Che Nung Station
  • Kou Fu Sui Station
  • Anne Park Station

  • , Sheung Che Nung Stop
  • Skuld Road Garden Stop

Passengers who take Nazca Railway from Halozy can walk to Red Millet Station of , or walk 5 minutes from Exit A of Red Millet Station to Sheung Che Nung Station of , or Sheung Che Nung Stop of , . However, most residents in Halozy use buses as external transport. Under normal circumstances, travelling to Python Delta and Downtown through Routes 4 and 7 takes 8 minutes and 20 minutes respectively.

Future Development

Currently, Halozy is still under development, and contains 100-130 thousand people. In the future, Sava Light Transit may be built as a means to diversify demands of travel to other districts. Moreover, plans to turn Java Beach and Comp Ward into a Commercial District may also mean that residents can work in the same district.

was the eighth line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between and , and had a total of 27 stations. It was established alongside Snowa Island Station on September 5 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description

was the eighth District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled from center Terracept Continent and made a detour to the southeast, before returning north and entered the east of Vertin Peninsula and Tropic Continent.

This line was represented by the Orange Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 7.

At the time of its closure, this route was 27.3 km long, with a total of 18 stations.

Fun Facts

  • The English Name of this station derives from the concept of Harvesting, where farmers usually harvest their crops at the end of a '''Year'''.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vY8onF-5jKU&t=2610s</ref>
  • The Chinese of the word '''Year''' derives from the Nian beast, which appears at the beginning of each year.
  • Black Wool is used in this station as the beginning of each year is at the '''Midnight''' of January 1, when the skies are almost always dark. Moreover, the aforementioned Nian beast also almost always appear in the dark.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vY8onF-5jKU&t=2630s</ref>
  • This station is the second of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate a math teacher who taught Railway Builder for a year at SKH Chan Young Secondary School, with the other two stations being Gentle Island Station and Virtel Heights Station.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vY8onF-5jKU&t=3191s</ref>https://www.skhcyss.edu.hk/CustomPage/27/01.htm</ref>
  • As this station is built with the theme of "Harvest" in mind, this station features eight different pieces of farmland, each featuring an item that can be planted on Farmlands, namely Beetroots, Wheat, Pumpkins, Melons, Sugar Canes Cocoa Beans, Carrots and Potatoes.
  • A set of Sidings is availble for Trains arriving at this station. However, while the trains arrive and leave the station at the north track and south track respectively, trains arriving from Waterbelt Garden Station and Shadow Shore Station would end up stopping at Platforms 3 and 4 respectively. This ensures that trains would not go back to the station from which it departed.
